headline: Yes — the isolated-model comparison supports residues 94–312 as the preferred starting region under the illustrative rule.
structure_check: The AlphaFold DB and course-fold models match the 393-residue wild-type p53 FASTA exactly; both are one isolated chain, not the functional p53 tetramer or a p53–MDM2 complex.
caveat: The isolated single-chain model cannot validate the experimental construct, tetramer assembly, or partner-bound conformation; a clean-looking 18–28 helix is not evidence of a fixed standalone target.
